The '''Corosian phoenix''' was a [[Bird/Legends|bird]] commonly regarded for its beauty. The [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] trooper [[Jangotat|Nate]] once saw one and briefly wanted to keep it as a pet, before deciding that doing so would go against military protocol.
